friction_layers.title: Marcus Aurelius and Stoic Virtue
friction_layers.observation: Humans recognize the need for virtue, discipline, and self-control.
friction_layers.pattern: Character shapes the direction of the soul and life.
friction_layers.friction_point: Human beings often recognize virtue but fail to fully live by it.
friction_layers.non_christian_resolution: Stoicism emphasizes reason, discipline, acceptance, and virtue.
friction_layers.christian_resolution: Christianity emphasizes grace, redemption through Christ, and transformation by the Holy Spirit.
friction_layers.divine_pattern_insight: Human reason can recognize moral order, but restoration after failure requires a deeper resolution.
